subs.math: 4,000 workflow runs a month, at one run per subscriber per campaign. Only the Novu platform cost is counted.
20,000 runs a month are assumed, within Pro's 30,000 included runs. The sender cost is extra.
40,000 runs a month: the Pro starting price, plus 10,000 extra runs. This is the platform minimum only.
200,000 runs a month: the Pro starting price, plus 170,000 extra runs. This is the platform minimum only.
